Created:   2026-03-08T22:46:13.408Z
Started:   2026-03-08T22:54:28.605Z

─── Spec Context ───
Session Storage Modes
Type: requirement
Implementation: in_progress
Description:
  Configurable session storage with two modes: local (default) and branch.
  Local mode writes to .kspec-sessions/ with no git tracking. Branch mode
  writes to .kspec-sessions/ backed by a named orphan branch for persistence.
  Shadow mode (sessions on kspec-meta) is legacy read-only — never written to.
Acceptance Criteria:
  [ac-config]
    Given: A kspec project with kynetic.yaml

    When: sessions.storage is set to "local" or "branch"

    Then: Session operations use the configured storage mode.

  [ac-config-default]
    Given: A kspec project with no sessions.storage in kynetic.yaml

    When: A session operation runs

    Then: Defaults to "local" mode.

  [ac-config-invalid]
    Given: sessions.storage is set to an unsupported value

    When: kspec validates the manifest

    Then: Zod validation error with message indicating valid values (local, branch).

  [ac-local-mode]
    Given: sessions.storage is "local" (or unconfigured)

    When: A session is created, events appended, or session closed

    Then: Files are written to .kspec-sessions/{id}/ with no git operations.

  [ac-branch-mode]
    Given: sessions.storage is "branch" with a branch name configured

    When: A session is created or closed

    Then: Files are written to .kspec-sessions/ which is a git worktree
on the configured orphan branch. Auto-commits on session lifecycle
boundaries (create, close, stale cleanup, compact) but NOT on every event append.

  [ac-branch-name]
    Given: sessions.storage is "branch"

    When: sessions.branch is set (e.g., "kspec-sessions")

    Then: The orphan branch uses the configured name.

  [ac-branch-name-default]
    Given: sessions.storage is "branch" with no sessions.branch set

    When: Session branch is initialized

    Then: Default branch name is "kspec-sessions".

  [ac-no-event-commits]
    Given: sessions.storage is "branch"

    When: An event is appended to events.jsonl during active session

    Then: No git commit occurs. Events are committed in bulk at session close.

  [ac-sessions-dir]
    Given: Any storage mode

    When: Session operations resolve file paths

    Then: Sessions directory is .kspec-sessions/ at project root,
separate from .kspec/ (which remains spec/task only).

  [ac-sessions-dir-autocreate]
    Given: .kspec-sessions/ directory does not exist

    When: A session create operation runs

    Then: The directory is created automatically (mkdir -p equivalent).

  [ac-gitignore]
    Given: A kspec project

    When: kspec init or kspec setup runs

    Then: .kspec-sessions/ is added to the project root .gitignore
(not tracked on main branch regardless of storage mode).


─── Notes ───
[2026-03-08T22:46:13.408Z] @claude:
Add sessions.storage (local|branch) and sessions.branch (string) to
kynetic.yaml schema. Default storage to "local". Validate in Zod schema.

[2026-03-08T22:57:45.417Z] @claude:
Added sessions config block to ManifestSchema in src/schema/spec.ts:
- sessions.storage: z.enum(['local', 'branch']).default('local')
- sessions.branch: z.string().optional()
- Entire sessions block is optional (.optional())

Test coverage in tests/schema/session-storage-config.test.ts (9 tests):
- AC ac-config: accepts 'local' and 'branch' values
- AC ac-config-default: defaults to 'local', undefined when omitted
- AC ac-config-invalid: rejects unsupported values with Zod error
- AC ac-branch-name: accepts string branch name

[2026-03-08T23:04:18.082Z] Jacob Chapel:
[FIX_CYCLE: 1] Review findings: MUST-FIX: schema does not default omitted sessions config to local, and ac-config-invalid test does not verify the error message lists valid values (local, branch).
